entities.summary: National Assembly, a political institution in Kuwait during Post-Liberation Reconstruction and Modernization (1991–2010). Grew from Last oil well fire extinguished. Led to the emergence of Kuwaiti women granted the right to vote and run for office and Arab Spring.
